Priya (Finance): Heads up — we have a token reconciliation gap for vendor stream nordstar-prod yesterday morning (asia window). Invoice shows ~62k tokens missing compared to ingest reports. Can ops/data look?
Luca (Data Eng): which exact window and customer?
Priya (Finance): window looks like 2026-03-20 03:00-03:15 UTC. Metering summary: 18k acks, tokenizer tokens=4.8M, expected ~6.1M.
Aisha (Billing): gap ~1.3M tokens -> est $78. Any sign of dropped batches or de-dupe?
Luca (Data Eng): checking logs now. Proxy logs show a restart on asia-proxy-7 at ~03:06 UTC. I see `partial_ack=true` markers and `offset_gap` messages. Possible replay suppression on the proxy.
eric-devex: paste the query you ran for counts?
Luca (Data Eng): here:
```
-- simplified
select shard, sum(tokens) as tokens, count(*) as events
from metered_events
where stream='nordstar-prod' and ts >= '2026-03-20T03:00:00Z' and ts < '2026-03-20T03:15:00Z'
group by shard;
```
ops-oncall: confirmed proxy restart. Log snippet: `2026-03-20T03:06:12Z asia-proxy-7 restart; outgoing ack stream resumed with offset_gap=125874`. Replay suppression flag set for ~90s.
metering-bot: auto-detect -> ingest-window-gap detected; stream=nordstar-prod; window=2026-03-20T03:00:00Z-2026-03-20T03:15:00Z; gap=1,330,412_tokens; created INC-2026-119.
Priya (Finance): we need decision: reprocess/backfill vs one-time credit. Reprocess cost/time?
Luca (Data Eng): reprocessing across shards will recompute token counts; estimate 2-3 hours. Needs de-dupe keys to avoid double-counting if upstream retries. Also requires a replay job and approval to touch historical metering tables.
Aisha (Billing): provisional credit OK up to $80 pending final reprocess. We'll flag as provisional on invoice. Priya please open BILL-ADJ ticket.
Priya (Finance): filing now. Attached calc and meter logs to INC-2026-119 and created BILL-ADJ-582. Tagging @Luca to post final delta when reprocess completes. Thanks everyone :pray:
